subject: Strategic Objectives sync + QBR briefing preparation
messages:
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
To: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, board@vcfirm.com
Date: Wed, 10 Jun 2026 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Strategic Objectives sync + QBR briefing preparation

Team —

I’m kicking off a short alignment thread to lock the strategic objectives we’ll present at the QBR and to confirm owners for the Q3 OKR set. The draft is in the linked doc; attached is a consolidated workbook with proposed metrics and initial targets. High level ask: please review and mark any objections or major edits by EOD Friday (2026-06-12 PDT).

Key context: QBR is on 2026-06-24. I’ll be presenting the company-wide strategic objectives and need a final, sign-off-ready slide deck by Tuesday 2026-06-22 so we have time for a rehearsal.

Immediate asks:
- Take 20–30 minutes to review the "Q3 Objectives" tab in the workbook and add owners/comments.
- If a metric is missing (esp. infra latency, cost/unit, and adoption funnel), add a row with a proposed measurement and owner.
- If you want to escalate a target (increase/decrease materially), flag it with a short rationale.

Attachments: Q3_OKR_proposals_v1.xlsx (xlsx) — master draft with tabs: Objectives, Metrics, Owners.
Links: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1QBR-Prep-Strategic-Objectives (doc with proposed narrative for slides)

I am copying Board distribution for visibility; please keep any sensitive numbers internal to this thread.

Thanks — let’s keep edits inline so we can iterate quickly.

—Evelyn
Evelyn Hart
VP, Product & Strategy
Redwood Inference

From: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 10 Jun 2026 16:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Strategic Objectives sync + QBR briefing preparation

Thanks, Evelyn — this is helpful. A few quick thoughts after a first pass: 

1) Consolidation: the Objectives tab has a few overlapping entries between "Serving" and "Platform" that will confuse reviewers. Suggest we collapse those into a single objective for "Inference Reliability & Cost Efficiency" with sub-metrics.

2) Metrics specificity: for latency I recommend a P50/P95/P99 bucketed view and a per-model cost/unit target rather than an aggregate cost. That will make rollup slides cleaner for executives.

3) Timeline: can we move the internal sign-off up to Monday EOD (2026-06-14)? That gives CS/Marketing time to prep decks and keeps us ahead of last-minute asks.

I’m attaching a small matrix with the metrics I’d expect from infra and platform to make it easy for owners to fill in.

Attachment: (ops-metrics-matrix.csv) — see infra metrics section.

Quick notes from infra/product ops POV — thanks for pulling this together, Evelyn. I added three small edits directly in the workbook and one suggestion below: 

- For adoption funnel, add a "time-to-first-inference" metric (days from signup to first successful API call) — this matters for PLG conversion velocity.
- For cost/unit, call out target ranges for best-effort vs. reserved capacity (gives sales/finance something concrete).
- For reliability, add an aspiration to reduce P99 tail by 20% while keeping median latency stable.

I’ve attached the ops metrics matrix David mentioned with sample payloads and sample collection queries to make it easier for owners to populate numbers.

Attachment: ops-metrics-matrix.csv (csv)

Thanks for the quick returns — this is exactly the level of specificity I was hoping for. Final notes and owners below; please treat this as close-to-final unless you raise a hard objection by EOD Monday (2026-06-14 17:00 PDT).

Final owners & action items:
- Inference Reliability & Cost Efficiency (owner: David Kim) — produce P50/P95/P99 latency table + per-model cost/unit by 2026-06-18.
- Adoption funnel & PLG conversion (owner: Aditya Rao) — add time-to-first-inference and funnel drop-off data by 2026-06-17.
- GTM readiness & slide copy (owner: Marissa Cole) — consolidate slides and narrative; initial deck due 2026-06-19.
- Compliance/data residency note (owner: Monica Patel) — add a single slide with any region-specific constraints for QBR by 2026-06-18.

Rehearsal: I’ll schedule a 30-minute dry run on 2026-06-22 at 10:00 AM PT — calendar invite to follow.

Attachments: Q3_OKR_proposals_v1.xlsx (final draft attached); ops-metrics-matrix.csv (David/Aditya additions).
Links: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1QBR-Prep-Strategic-Objectives (final narrative)

If there are any blockers (data not available, owners overloaded), call that out in the sheet and ping me directly. Otherwise I’ll treat this as sign-off-ready after Monday.

—Evelyn
